goals.text: Each package keeps its code, its APM package and its version in its own folder.

outcomes.change: kmctl's APM package lives in packages/kmctl/apm and kmaudit's version in packages/kmaudit/apm/apm.yml
outcomes.checked_by: the starter bootstrap integration test (a release after the cutoff, `path: packages/kmctl/apm`, doctor passes); test_starter renders `path: apm` at v0.12.2 and `path: packages/kmctl/apm` at v0.13.0; doctor and plugin patch tests recognise kmctl's entry and sub-packages under both paths and new_entry writes the new one; release.py tests read kmctl's version from packages/kmctl/apm/apm.yml and kmaudit's from packages/kmaudit/apm/apm.yml, `manifest` falls back to apm/apm.yml on an old commit, and `set --package kmaudit` writes the apm.yml; the package build test checks both wheels' versions and contents; a test that no `apm/` folder and no `packages/kmaudit/VERSION` remain

problems.text: kmctl's APM package sits at the repository root while its code is in packages/kmctl, and kmaudit has no APM package, so kmaudit's version lives in a VERSION file against the repository's convention.
